name: Sun-Sea Construction Corporation
summary: Sun-Sea Construction Corporation operates within Taiwan's building and civil engineering sectors. Its diverse portfolio encompasses the development of various structures, from commercial complexes, parking facilities, educational institutions, technological plants, and hospitality venues (restaurants and hotels), to residential developments. Furthermore, the company undertakes significant civil engineering initiatives, such as roads, bridges, tunnels, and associated infrastructure. Beyond construction, Sun-Sea offers a comprehensive suite of services including project planning, architectural design, and construction management. They also contribute expertise in urban renewal projects, provide consulting and integration services, and oversee project commissioning. Established in 1971, the corporation maintains its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
